meta.name: document-in-case
meta.description: Add a comment to a case to document findings, actions, or recommendations. Use to maintain audit trail during investigations. Requires CASE_ID and comment text.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为案件添加备注，记录调查过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在调查中记录发现和操作
copy.tagline_en: Add comments to cases to document investigation actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to document findings during case investigations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能向 SOAR 案例添加标准化评论，记录调查发现、操作或建议，并确认评论发布成功。
howto.when: 当你提供案例 ID 和评论内容时触发，用于在调查过程中保持审计追踪。

say.text: 给案例 SOC-123 添加一段关于 IOC 丰富结果的评论。
say.note: 会使用富集摘要模板生成结构化评论。

say.text: 把调查更新写入案例 CASE-456，描述已完成的操作和下一步计划。
say.note: 会生成调查更新格式的评论。

say.text: 在案例 ALERT-789 中记录分类决策为误报并说明原因。
say.note: 会使用分类决策模板。可能要求额外信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can post standardized comments to SOAR cases to document findings, actions, or recommendations, and verify the comment was posted successfully.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a case ID and comment text, used to maintain an audit trail during investigations.

say_en.text: Add a comment to case SOC-123 summarizing IOC enrichment results.
Write an investigation update to case CASE-456 with completed actions and next steps.
say_en.note: Generates an investigation update format comment.

say_en.text: Record a triage decision of false positive in case ALERT-789 with rationale.
say_en.note: Uses the triage decision template. May require additional info.
